lines.en: A row of needles rises along my back.
I move low to the ground, very lightly.
My needle tips scratch the trunk.
I am aiming with every step.
This hide was never meant to walk.

lines.zh: 我绕着圈，离你越来越近。
lines.en: I circle, closing the distance.
One needle slides up to my shoulder.
I pause to line my needles up.

lines.zh: 我身子一抖，针响了一声。
lines.en: I twitch, and the needles click.

lines.zh: 我沿着矮墙慢慢蹭过去。
lines.en: I creep along the low wall.
I lower my neck, needle tips forward.
I make no sound, only approach.

lines.zh: 针尖对着你的侧腰，我绕过去。
lines.en: My tips aim at your flank as I circle.

lines.zh: 风从背后吹，你闻不到我。
lines.en: The wind comes from behind; you can't smell me.

lines.zh: 草被我的针压出一条路。
lines.en: My needles flatten a path through the grass.
I drag myself along, as if enduring something.
My needles stay up; I wait.
I tilt my head and the tips tremble.
I am choosing which needle goes first.

lines.zh: 身体里的东西挪了位置。
lines.en: Something inside me has shifted.
I press against the wall and do not move.

lines.zh: 你第七步会踩到我的射程。
lines.en: Your seventh step enters my range.
One needle has a spot of rust.
I stretch my body out a little.

lines.zh: 我盯着路面，像在算距离。
lines.en: I stare at the path as if measuring distance.
When the wind stops, I move.
My breathing is slow, almost nothing.

lines.zh: 你的心跳隔着草传过来。
lines.en: Your heartbeat reaches me through the grass.

lines.zh: 有一根针歪了，我很在意。
lines.en: One needle is crooked, and it bothers me.
I tighten the needles one by one.
There is no shadow of me on the ground.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转，把你放在正面。
lines.en: I turn slowly to keep you in front.
You stand just right — close enough.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，针也抬起来。
lines.en: I look up at you and my needles rise.
Don't look down at my back.
You have a faint smell of iron.
I know what you are calculating.
You eye me; I am measuring you too.
I tilt my head so you can see clearly.
I fire at three. Step back.
My hide is thinner than you think.
Don't reach out; I will move first.

lines.zh: 你听到那种细细的声音了吗？
lines.en: Do you hear that thin whistling?
Every needle is up; I wait for you to come nearer.
Two of my needles are knocked crooked.
I pull back, shrinking in on myself.
My hide splits and something moves inside.
Don't step on my back.
I let out a thin sound.

lines.zh: 这一下让我少了一根针。
lines.en: That cost me a needle.
I curl up to protect the tips.
My needles twitch, but I make no sound.
I shudder and lose my footing.
I raise one more needle.

lines.zh: 那东西能换你一条命吗？
lines.en: Can that buy you your life?
I smell it, but I cannot eat.
Set it down and take three steps back.
I do not use my mouth; I use needles.

lines.zh: 那味道让我想射点什么。
lines.en: That smell makes me want to launch something.
Don't wave it; my aim will drift.
I inch forward half a block.

lines.zh: 针尖自己朝你转过去了。
lines.en: My tips turn toward you on their own.
Show it to me. Don't offer it as food.
I am holding back, and it is unpleasant.
I still have many on my back.
Raise it one inch higher.
I heard you swallow.
Let us shorten the distance a little.
No hurry; I am good at waiting.
Your fingers are moving.
You bumped into me, and a tip caught you.
I recoil, and every needle stands up.

lines.zh: 我的身体很软，骨头很多。
lines.en: My body is soft and full of bones.
Don't shove me; I will spill.

lines.zh: 我们碰在一起，声音很轻。
lines.en: We touch, and the sound is faint.

lines.zh: 尾巴一抽，一根针立起来。
lines.en: My tail jerks and a needle rises.

lines.zh: 身子像水一样从腿边绕过。
lines.en: My body flows around your leg like water.
A needle tip goes into your sleeve.
You retreat, and I make way.

lines.zh: 这一下不算攻击，只是碰。
lines.en: That was not an attack, only contact.
I keep the straightest needle for you.
Lean on me, but don't crush the needles.
I drape this hide over your shoulders.
I speak little; don't mind it.
I retract my needles. See?
We lie low in the grass together.
Touch my back, slowly.
I will never launch at you.
Follow me; I know the way.

lines.zh: 我把身体靠得更近一点。
lines.en: I press my body a little closer.
I could use this as a needle.
I curl it up and take it inside me.
On the ground means I take it first.
Its tip is decent.
I stick it into my back.
This is too small to matter.

lines.zh: 我捡了两根，剩下一根给你。
lines.en: I took two; the last one is yours.
I bite down and slowly stow it away.
Whatever falls is mine.
I sniff first, then take it.
I plant myself, needle tips at you.
You are in my range now.

lines.zh: 针贴着草面，几乎看不见。
lines.en: My needles lie at grass level, nearly invisible.
Hold still and let me aim.
Wind, distance, angle — all right.

lines.zh: 我已经选好了你身上的一处。
lines.en: I have already chosen a spot on you.
I launch first, then approach.
Every needle on my back has risen.
The shadow moves first; the person follows.
I am at your flank, not your front.

lines.zh: 第一根偏了，还有第二根。
lines.en: The first missed; there is a second.
I shift my angle and aim again.

lines.zh: 你躲到树后，树干不够厚。
lines.en: You hide behind a tree; the trunk is too thin.
One shift and the range drops a block.
My tips follow your shoulder.
Your hand is shaking. I see it.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，从草里看你。
lines.en: I stay low and watch you through the grass.
Move left, and I move left.
You lead with the left; your right shoulder drops.
The second is already loaded.

lines.zh: 一根针飞出去，扎在你腿上。
lines.en: A needle flies and sticks in your leg.
At this range you cannot block it.
The second follows.
I slam in with every tip forward.
This one went deep.
There is a needle in your shoulder now.
I only fire once I am close.
The needle's tail is still quivering.
I draw one out and drive it back in.
Blood runs down the needle.

lines.zh: 缝很窄，我把身体压薄了。
lines.en: The gap is narrow; I thinned myself to fit.
A row of needles rises in the grass.
I unfold my body for the first time.
The wind is mild here. Good.
I try raising one needle.
There are footprints. I remember them.
Clods of dirt fall from between my needles.
I haven't decided who to shoot first.
I startle the birds away.
My hide is new and still soft.

lines.zh: 我的针被烧软了，弯下去。
lines.en: The fire softens my needles and they bend.
I fell, and several needles snapped.

lines.zh: 水把我整条浸透，动不了。
lines.en: Water soaks me through and I cannot move.

lines.zh: 气浪把我的针全掀翻了。
lines.en: The blast flattens every needle I have.

lines.zh: 有东西射穿了我，我也被扎了。
lines.en: Something shot through me; now I am pierced too.

lines.zh: 紫色的光让我的针发麻。
lines.en: Violet light numbs my needles.
Hunger keeps me from raising a needle.

lines.zh: 我往下掉，针一根根散开。
lines.en: I fall, and my needles scatter one by one.
